core_question: Did the docs-handoff push also deploy cleanly, and is the live site still serving the verified build with its crawlable content intact?
knowns: The design payload was already deployed and verified: Actions run 35692523975 concluded success on 0441196, and the live page served css/e04c3c24b311d9c0.css with 674 characters of crawlable body text
A second push 0441196..9005381 carried only docs changes — NEXT_STEPS, EVENTS, PLAN, PROGRESS, REQUIREMENTS and RUN_CONTEXT — with no source or asset edits
gh run watch on that second run exited 0, so the workflow reported success; only the pre-existing Node 20 deprecation and ubuntu-latest migration annotations were emitted
npm run build exported 6/6 routes and npm run lint reported zero warnings on the tree that was pushed
The merged branch feat/design-refresh was deleted locally after the fast-forward, and git status reported main in sync with origin/main
Because the docs commit touches no file under src/ or public/, the exported bundle hash cannot change, so the live CSS hash should still be e04c3c24b311d9c0
unknowns: If curl of https://junjslee.github.io/ returns 0 matches for css/e04c3c24b311d9c0.css, the second deploy replaced the artifact with a different build and the assumption that a docs-only commit cannot move the bundle hash fails
If the live home page now reports fewer than 600 characters of crawlable body text, the pre-hydration shim was dropped from the artifact and indexing of the home page fails
Should gh run list report the most recent run with conclusion failure rather than success, the docs deploy errored and the previously deployed artifact is what visitors still see
When git status is checked, if main is reported ahead of origin/main by 1 or more commits then the final push did not land and the handoff fails to reach the remote
assumptions: A docs-only commit is inert for the published site, because the Next.js export reads only src/ and public/ and the docs tree is outside both
Rollback stays cheap: git revert of the docs commit plus a push restores the previous state, and no source or asset change is involved to undo
disconfirmation: If curl of https://junjslee.github.io/ returns 0 matches for css/e04c3c24b311d9c0.css, or the latest Actions run reports conclusion failure, the deploy regressed and the offending commit gets reverted and pushed rather than left live
patch_vs_refactor_evaluation: Nothing is edited in this phase. It reads the GitHub Actions run status for the docs push, fetches https://junjslee.github.io/ and measures the served bundle hash and body-text length, and reads git status — no file under src/, public/ or docs/ is touched, so analysis is the honest posture.

blast_radius_map.rationale: read-only verification; the artifact is fetched and measured, never rewritten
already written and pushed in the handoff commit; re-editing it here would append to a REPLACE-form file
the E4 row for this handoff is already appended, and the contract allows exactly one row per handoff
the deployed source is frozen and verified; this phase only observes the published result

sync_plan.action: re-author with the verification-phase posture and record the measured result in the session report

deferred_discoveries.description: Five actions/* steps in the Pages workflow target the deprecated Node 20 and are being forced onto Node 24, and ubuntu-latest migrates to Ubuntu 26 from 2026-10-19
deferred_discoveries.observable: If a future deploy run exits non-zero with a Node or runner-image error after 2026-10-19, these annotations became real failures rather than warnings
deferred_discoveries.log_only_rationale: Bumping action versions changes CI behaviour and belongs in its own change with its own verification, not appended to a deploy that already succeeded
